subject: Workplace Skills
title: No-Meeting Days
description: A quick win: understand No-Meeting Days.

hook.text: Asana introduced No Meeting Wednesdays and reported that focus work output on those days jumped 40 percent.

buildup.text: Fragmented calendars destroy deep work. Even a single meeting in a four-hour block fractures concentration.

discovery.text: No-meeting days create protected time for deep work. They signal that focus is valued as much as collaboration.

twist.text: Exceptions erode the policy fast. Without enforcement, no-meeting days fill up within weeks.

climax.text: Block the calendar company-wide. Allow exceptions only with VP approval. The cost of overriding must be visible.

punchline.text: Protect one day fiercely. Deep work needs unbroken time.

quiz.question: Why do no-meeting days require strict enforcement?
options: People will schedule personal appointments instead
Exceptions erode the policy quickly and it fills up within weeks
Not everyone needs deep work time
